### The Allurement of Christ
Author: Nicholas Batzig
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/allurement-of-christ
Passage: Proverbs 7:1-27
Points:
- A father cautions his son about the seductive appeal of the adulteress, illustrating how sin pulls the human heart.
- Sin provides a real though temporary pleasure, blinding the simple to the deadly consequences of their choices.
- Human hearts cannot simply cease desiring; worldly lust must be displaced by a stronger affection.
- Christ alone possesses the superior beauty needed to draw our desires away from destructive temptations.
- Focusing on Jesus provides the expulsive power to overcome the alluring pull of sinful pleasure.

### Wisdom and the Forbidden Woman
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/wisdom-and-forbidden-woman
Passage: Proverbs 7:1-20
Points:
- Sexual immorality is one of the most powerful temptations in a fallen world, ensnaring even godly individuals like David.
- The vital safeguard against seductive traps is internalizing God's wisdom and memorizing His Word before temptation strikes.
- Jesus modeled this defense during His wilderness testing by confronting temptation with biblical truth.
- The smooth speech of the adulteress makes appealing promises that cannot be fulfilled and lures people toward spiritual idolatry.
- Christians must flee sexual sin not merely to protect family relationships, but to guard their vital union with Christ.
